page_title: Distill — Latest articles about machine learning

summary.name: Distill
summary.one_liner: Distill is a website of interactive, visually explained machine learning research articles, listed on its page as having taken a break after five years.
use_cases: reading research on neural network interpretability
studying hyperparameter tuning with Bayesian optimization
exploring t-SNE and dimensionality reduction pitfalls
summary.what_it_does: The page is a list of Distill articles about machine learning, each with authors and a one-line description. Topics include graph neural networks, multimodal neurons, deep reinforcement learning attribution, feature visualization and activation atlases, Bayesian hyperparameter optimization, t-SNE, CTC for speech and handwriting recognition, GAN artifacts, attention, and momentum in optimization. The articles are described as interactive and visual. The page includes an editorial note that Distill is taking a break after five years.
notable: Interactive, visually explained ML research articles
Archive covers graph neural networks, interpretability, and feature visualization
Includes open-source code for some articles, such as convnet receptive fields
caveats: Editorial team states Distill is taking a break after five years, so new articles may not appear
